# KiwiFS

> Markdown filesystem for agents and teams. Searchable. Structured. Versioned.

KiwiFS is a single Go binary that turns markdown files on disk into a searchable, queryable, versioned store accessible via REST, MCP, NFS, S3, WebDAV, and FUSE. Files on disk are the source of truth; every write is a git commit, a search index update, and an SSE event.

## Docs

- Full documentation: https://docs.kiwifs.com
- Full LLM reference: https://docs.kiwifs.com/llms-full.txt
- OpenAPI spec (self-hosted): GET /api/openapi.json
- Swagger UI (self-hosted): GET /api/docs

## Quickstart

    OS=$(uname -s | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')
    ARCH=$(uname -m | sed -e 's/x86_64/amd64/' -e 's/aarch64/arm64/')
    curl -fsSL "https://github.com/kiwifs/kiwifs/releases/latest/download/kiwifs-$OS-$ARCH.tar.gz" | tar -xz
    sudo mv "kiwifs-$OS-$ARCH" /usr/local/bin/kiwifs
    kiwifs init --root ./knowledge          # default template: kb
    kiwifs serve --root ./knowledge
    # Web UI, REST API, and MCP (/mcp) at http://localhost:3333

Docker: docker run -d -p 3333:3333 -v kiwifs-data:/data ameliaanhlam/kiwifs

Templates (kiwifs init --template <name>): kb (default), wiki, adr, cms, data, log, memory, prompt, research, runbook, tasks, blank

## MCP setup

KiwiFS ships a built-in MCP server with 78 tools. `kiwifs serve` always exposes it over streamable HTTP at /mcp.

### Claude Desktop / Cursor (stdio)

    {
      "mcpServers": {
        "kiwifs": {
          "command": "kiwifs",
          "args": ["mcp", "--root", "/path/to/knowledge"]
        }
      }
    }

### Proxy to a running server

    kiwifs mcp --remote https://kiwi.example.com --api-key $KIWI_API_KEY [--space docs]

### Standalone streamable HTTP

    kiwifs mcp --root ./knowledge --http --port 8181

## KiwiFS Cloud

Hosted KiwiFS at https://app.kiwifs.com. Workspace MCP endpoint:

    https://api.kiwifs.com/api/workspaces/{slug}/mcp

## REST API (key endpoints)

Base URL: http://localhost:3333/api/kiwi

    GET    /tree                      Directory tree
    GET    /file?path=<path>          Read a file (ETag = git blob hash)
    PUT    /file?path=<path>          Create or update (If-Match for optimistic locking; 409 on conflict)
    PATCH  /file/frontmatter          Patch frontmatter fields
    DELETE /file?path=<path>          Delete a file
    POST   /rename                    Move or rename a file
    POST   /bulk                      Atomic multi-file write
    POST   /file/append               Append without read-modify-write
    GET    /search?q=<query>          Full-text search (BM25)
    POST   /search/semantic           Vector similarity search
    GET    /query?q=<dql>             DQL query over frontmatter
    GET    /versions?path=<path>      Git history
    GET    /diff?path=<p>&from=&to=   Diff between versions
    GET    /backlinks?path=<path>     Incoming wiki links
    GET    /graph/analytics           PageRank, hubs, orphans
    POST   /refactor/plan             Plan moves and merges without breaking links
    POST   /refactor/apply            Apply a reviewed refactor plan
    POST   /drafts                    Create a draft space (needs [drafts] enabled = true)
    GET    /context                   Playbook, rules, schema, and index in one call
    GET    /events                    SSE real-time events

Auth: Bearer token in the Authorization header when auth is enabled. Set X-Actor on writes for git attribution. Multi-space servers route by the X-Kiwi-Space header.

## MCP tools (78)

Files: kiwi_read, kiwi_write, kiwi_append, kiwi_bulk_write, kiwi_patch_frontmatter, kiwi_delete, kiwi_rename, kiwi_tree, kiwi_peek, kiwi_section, kiwi_versions, kiwi_changes, kiwi_view_refresh
Search: kiwi_search, kiwi_search_semantic, kiwi_search_hybrid, kiwi_brief, kiwi_similar, kiwi_eval
Context and queries: kiwi_context, kiwi_query, kiwi_query_meta, kiwi_aggregate
Links and graph: kiwi_backlinks, kiwi_suggestions, kiwi_embeddings, kiwi_graph_analytics, kiwi_graph_centrality, kiwi_graph_communities, kiwi_graph_path, kiwi_graph_walk
Restructuring: kiwi_refactor_plan, kiwi_refactor_apply, kiwi_refactor_script, kiwi_refactor_revert
Analytics: kiwi_analytics, kiwi_health_check, kiwi_velocity, kiwi_timeline, kiwi_feed
Authoring: kiwi_lint, kiwi_widget_reference, kiwi_quiz
Import and export: kiwi_import, kiwi_ingest, kiwi_clip, kiwi_cite, kiwi_export, kiwi_export_document
Tasks and claims: kiwi_eligible, kiwi_task_create, kiwi_task_progress, kiwi_claim, kiwi_release, kiwi_claims_list
Workflows: kiwi_workflow_list, kiwi_workflow_get, kiwi_workflow_save, kiwi_workflow_advance, kiwi_workflow_board
Drafts: kiwi_draft_create, kiwi_draft_list, kiwi_draft_write, kiwi_draft_read, kiwi_draft_diff, kiwi_draft_merge, kiwi_draft_discard
Saved views: kiwi_views_list, kiwi_views_get, kiwi_views_save, kiwi_views_delete, kiwi_views_execute
Canvas: kiwi_canvas_list, kiwi_canvas_read, kiwi_canvas_write
Memory: kiwi_remember, kiwi_forget, kiwi_memory_report

## Widgets

Fenced code blocks render as interactive widgets in the web UI and degrade to plain code elsewhere. Call kiwi_widget_reference for the exact schema of every fence, and kiwi_lint to validate a page.

Data structures: array, matrix, table, tree, list, stack, queue, map, bits, memory
Charts and plots: plot, bars, numberline, plane, timeline, kiwi-chart, kiwi-progress
Diagrams: graph, sequence, steps, mermaid (steppable), d2 (rendered server-side)
Interactive: quiz callouts, kiwi-calc, kiwi-playground, kiwi-app, widget:live, widget:code
Data and queries: kiwi-query, kiwi-data, kiwi-kanban, widget:tracker
Page structure: callouts, tabs and columns, figures, claims, kiwi-diff, kiwi-color
